authorization.scope: owner approved one additional fresh native baseline operation via structured decision #1710 after diagnosing the v6 missed query slot; preserve the frozen workload and 250 ms query schedule. If v7 is blocked or query acceptance is still inconclusive, stop and report; no automatic retry or further run under this authorization. No SWE-QA20 or P2 performance work

code_candidate.note: The lifecycle harness runs the native IndexStore code compiled into the current zg-daemon unit-test binary, bound to the tracked worktree diff hash above. It includes the post-v4 test-only fix that records successful watcher-job completion revisions, the v6 test-only close/flush-before-reopen fix, and a focused regression proving the indexed fixture survives that reopen. It does not execute or import the npm package or use production transport. The package hashes remain a validated provenance reference to the earlier local WIP package; the actual test binary and native shared-library identities are recorded in the operation manifest.

corpus.selection: first 64 paths in lexicographic order at source_commit

workload.fixture_mutations: append a unique synthetic FTS marker to selected frozen Rust files; rename one marked file, then delete it
workload.embedding: deterministic fixed 2D test embedding; no model inference or network access
workload.native_store: native IndexStore, fresh operation-owned index root, one writer and concurrent readers; close/flush the existing lease after readers quiesce before reopening the same path

query.schedule: one serial query offered every 250 ms; no overlap or queue; missed starts are counted and not backfilled
query.p95: nearest-rank p95 of successful end-to-end search_workspace_index wall time
query.validity: p95 acceptance is inconclusive if fewer than 20 queries complete, any scheduled slot is missed, any query fails, the sample cap is reached, or maximum schedule lag exceeds one interval

freshness.start: test-only monotonic timestamp when WorkspaceRuntime watch_loop receives a normalized non-empty batch
freshness.end: completion of the first successful scheduled FTS query that reflects the mutation

resource_envelope.pre_exec_guard: exec_guard.py verifies effective memory, swap, CPU, PID, the 1 GiB launch-only disk cushion, the 16 GB operational disk floor, and host-memory reserve before running the test binary
resource_envelope.disk_guard_action: stop the operation scope and preserve partial evidence if available bytes fall below the reserve
resource_envelope.scratch_policy: all generated files and TMPDIR stay under operation root; no per-workspace quota is claimed

stop_conditions.on_guard_breach: stop the scoped workload, retain partial evidence, classify the run as blocked/partial, and do not retry

decision_policy.if_sampling_is_incomplete: report exploratory/inconclusive; do not repeat under this authorization. This is the one additional attempt approved after v6 diagnosis; if v7 is still inconclusive or blocked, stop and require a fresh owner authorization/protocol before any further run
